spans.s:
sadha-mā́da, m. co-revelry, συμπόσιον,
common feast; sadhamādam mad, revel
in bliss with, w. instr. [1290.]

sadhá-stha, n. (orig., perhaps, co-place,
i. e. place of union, but generalized to the
simple mg of) place.

sādhyá, grdv. to be won; as m. pl.
Sādhyas, a class of deities. [√sādh.]
